Perform a tap action on the selected phone.

  The coordinate form takes x and y as frame-space pixels, with (0,0) at the screen's top-left.

  Use --query to find an element by natural-language description and tap its center in one step: the phone waits for the
  target to appear (up to 5 seconds) before tapping. On a session with accessibility mode on, --role, --name, and --id
  select the element from the accessibility tree instead; every given selector must match. If coordinates are also
  provided, --query takes precedence, as do --role, --name, and --id.

  Session selection precedence is --session, AXILIO_SESSION, the only locally saved session, the most recently started
  session, then an ambiguity error.

  USAGE

    axilio phone tap [x y] [--flags]

  EXAMPLES

    axilio phone tap --query "the search box"
    # stdout: Tapped "the search box" at 540,620
    # stderr: none
    # exit status: 0

    axilio phone tap 540 1200
    # stdout: Tapped 540,1200
    # stderr: none
    # exit status: 0

    axilio phone tap --session sess_123 --query "continue"
    # stdout: Tapped "continue" at 540,1120
    # stderr: none
    # exit status: 0

    axilio phone tap --role button --name "Log in"
    # stdout: Tapped button "Log in" at 540,1480
    # stderr: none
    # exit status: 0
    # note: Selected from the accessibility tree; needs accessibility mode on the
    # session.

    axilio phone tap --id com.example.app:id/login
    # stdout: Tapped #com.example.app:id/login at 540,1480
    # stderr: none
    # exit status: 0

  TAP FLAGS

    --exact       Require a case-sensitive exact match on --name
    -h --help     Help for tap
    --id          Android resource id, e.g. com.example.app:id/login; needs accessibility mode
    --model       Vision model for --query only; omitted lets the server select
    --name        Accessible name, e.g. "Log in"; needs accessibility mode
    --ocr-engine  Ocr engine for --query only: free or premium; omitted uses free
    --query       Recommended natural-language target; vision finds it and taps its center
    --role        Accessibility role, e.g. button or textbox; needs accessibility mode
    --strategy    Resolver: auto, vision, or accessibility; omitted uses auto (the tree when on, else vision)

  PHONE FLAGS

    --session  Session ID; overrides AXILIO_SESSION and automatic session selection

  GLOBAL FLAGS

    --api-key    No effect; the session's embedded control token in the websocket URL authenticates phone commands
    --base-url   No effect on phone tap command; it does not call the Axilio API
    --no-color   No effect on phone tap command; its runtime message is unstyled
    --org        No effect on phone tap command; the target is selected by session, not org
    -o --output  Emit a human confirmation or JSON tap result (table)
    -q --quiet   Suppress the human tap result; the phone action still runs; JSON still prints
